items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: so was Massengail on the trumpet

ctx.x: anyway, that's what we...we used to play mostly for the Mexicans--about five pieces, you know, and at least two nights a week, and they wanted jazz, you know. 'Course, Gene was a great piano player, and so was Massengail on the trumpet, you know, and they liked all that stuff.
When you first got to L.A., can you remember your first impressions of the city--what it looked like?
